d: ASICO Real Estate is looking for a creative, organized, and results-focused Marketing Executive to support property marketing, strengthen our digital presence, and generate qualified enquiries.

You will plan and execute campaigns for off-plan properties, ready properties, and rentals, working closely with the sales team and creative partners to turn property information into compelling marketing content.
Execute marketing campaigns across social media, email, property portals, and digital advertising.
Manage the content calendar and coordinate posts, property features, community highlights, and campaign launches.
Write engaging captions, listing descriptions, email copy, and promotional materials.
Coordinate property photography, video shoots, reels, and walkthroughs with agents and creative teams.
Keep website and property portal listings accurate, up to date, and consistent with approved property details.
Support Google and Meta advertising campaigns, including creative coordination, lead tracking, and performance reporting.
Work with the sales team to promote priority listings, support viewings and open houses, and gather feedback on lead quality.
Maintain consistent branding across digital content, brochures, presentations, and other marketing materials.
Research Dubai communities, audience interests, competitor activity, and relevant market developments.
Track campaign spending, website traffic, engagement, enquiries, and cost per qualified lead.
Coordinate suppliers and marketing activities to meet agreed timelines and budgets.
Check property claims, prices, availability, and promotional details before publication, following internal approval processes.
q: 2–4 years of experience in marketing, digital marketing, or a similar role.
Strong English copywriting and communication skills.
Experience managing social media channels and content calendars.
Familiarity with Meta Ads Manager, Google Ads, and marketing analytics.
Working knowledge of Canva or Adobe Creative Suite.
Ability to coordinate photo and video production and provide clear creative briefs.
Strong organisational skills and attention to detail.
A practical understanding of lead generation and collaboration with sales teams.
Ability to manage multiple campaigns and deadlines.
A degree in Marketing, Communications, Business, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
Experience in UAE real estate marketing.
Familiarity with Property Finder, Bayut, and CRM platforms.
Basic video editing and short-form content creation skills.
Knowledge of SEO, website content management, and email marketing tools.
Familiarity with Dubai property advertising requirements and approval processes.
x: A dynamic and collaborative work environment with growth potential.

d: Overall Objective: Responsible for supporting business growth through data analyses, timely and effective communication with relevant stakeholders and recommending actions to meet the POP objectives. Responsible for ecommerce sales for the respective portfolio.
Drive the analysis and provide meaningful insights to develop the business
Support the Sales Management in communication of the sales targets/ business priorities to the sales team in a timely and effective manner
Plan communicate and track in market activities in coordination with the internal and external stakeholders, participate in monthly forecasting
Analyze spends and communicate with the view to optimize ROI
Drive ecommerce business for the allocated brands
Evaluate and identify market trends by way of competitor tracking, pricing, promotion, opportunities and communicate the observations to concerned managers
Analyze and provide recommendations/ action plan based on scan data reports
Maintain and update the core distribution and merchandising guidelines by agency/ outlet type
q: Minimum 2-3 years of experience in FMCG and Analytical role
Advanced knowledge in MS office, knowledge of SAP, market knowledge or sales experience will be desirable
